confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and the supplied comparables; no live listings or booking pages were checked, so July 2026 levels are unverified. Restaurant and dorm anchors are the most reliable; hotel anchors, especially the 3-star, are the least certain. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer anchor (roughly 2.2 and 2.8 times beer) because direct knowledge of those prices is weaker.
comparable_city_reasoning: Chiang Mai is generally priced below Phuket and above Yogyakarta: Phuket was the upper reference for Thai restaurant and hotel levels, and Yogyakarta the lower reference for budget food and dorms. Koh Samui hotel figures (132.50 basic, 247.34 three-star) look like resort outliers against Phuket and were not used directly.
